blocks.text: **so** va **such** ikkalasi ham kuchaytiradi: «shunchalik», «shu qadar», «shunaqangi», «juda ham». Ma'nosi deyarli bir xil, farqi **grammatikada** — ulardan keyin nima keladi. **so** + sifat yoki ravish (ot yo'q): **so** tired, **so** quickly. **such** + (a / an) + (sifat) + **ot**: **such a** nice day, **such** nice people. O'zbekchada bu farq yo'q — «shunchalik charchadim» ham, «shunday yaxshi kun» ham bitta so'z bilan aytiladi. Shuning uchun asosiy xato — «so nice day» kabi aralash shakl.

rows: so + sifat: It was **so** cold.
such a + sifat + birlik ot: It was **such a** cold day.
so + ravish: She speaks **so** quickly.
such + sifat + ko'plik ot: They're **such** nice people.
so much / so many + ot: **so many** people
such + sanalmaydigan ot: **such** awful weather
so + sifat (natija): **so** tired **that** ...
such a + ot (sifatsiz): **such a** mess, **such a** pity

blocks.text: **so** sifat yoki ravishdan oldin keladi: **so** expensive, **so** well. U **very** dan farqli ravishda ko'pincha **his-tuyg'u** yoki **vaziyatdan ma'lum** narsaga ishora qiladi. It's very cold today — oddiy xabar. It's **so** cold! — titrab turib, his bilan aytilgan gap. Why are you **so** late? — kechikkanini ikkalamiz ham bilamiz. Shuningdek **so** ko'pincha natijani bildiruvchi **that** bilan keladi (pastda).

items.text: Your flat looks **so** different with the new curtains!
items.translation: Yangi pardalar bilan kvartirangiz **butunlay** boshqacha ko'rinyapti!

items.text: I'm **so** glad you could come to my birthday party.
items.translation: Tug'ilgan kunimga kela olganingdan **juda ham** xursandman.

items.text: Why do the trains here run **so** slowly?
items.translation: Nega bu yerda poyezdlar **bunchalik** sekin yuradi?

blocks.text: **such** artikldan **oldin** turadi: **such a** nice day («a such nice day» emas). Ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlarda **a** ishlatilmaydi: **such** nice people, **such** good advice, **such** lovely weather. Sanalmaydigan otlarga e'tibor bering — weather, advice, news, information, traffic, fun, luck: «such a beautiful weather» — xato. **such** sifatsiz, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ot bilan ham keladi: **such a** mess, **such a** hurry, **such** fun, **such an** idiot.

items.text: Thank you for **such a** wonderful evening.
I've never met **such** helpful people as in Bukhara.
items.translation: Buxorodagidek **bunchalik** yordamga tayyor odamlarni hech uchratmaganman.

items.text: Don't drive in **such** heavy snow — wait until tomorrow.
items.translation: **Bunaqa** qalin qorda mashina haydama — ertagacha kut.

blocks.text: Natijani aytish uchun: **so** + sifat + **that** ... yoki **such** + (a) + sifat + ot + **that** ... O'zbekchada bunga «**shunchalik** ... **ki**, ...» to'g'ri keladi: The film was **so** long **that** I fell asleep — Film **shunchalik** uzun ediki, uxlab qoldim. Og'zaki nutqda **that** ko'pincha tushib qoladi: I was **so** tired I went straight to bed.

items.text: The coffee was **so** strong **that** I couldn't sleep all night.
items.translation: Qahva **shunchalik** quyuq ediki, tun bo'yi uxlay olmadim.

items.text: It was **such** a hot day **that** the roads were melting.
items.translation: Kun **shunchalik** issiq ediki, yo'llardagi asfalt erib ketayotgan edi.

items.text: She was **so** surprised she couldn't say a word.
items.translation: U **shunchalik** hayron qoldiki, bir og'iz ham gapira olmadi.

blocks.text: so long / such a long time, so far / such a long way

Ba'zi iboralarda bir xil ma'noni ikki yo'l bilan aytish mumkin. **long** va **far** yolg'iz kelsa — **so**; ot bilan kelsa (time, way) — **such a**. **so much / so many** o'rnida norasmiy **such a lot (of)** ham ishlatiladi (much / many farqi → qizil kitob, 83-dars; → 87-dars). «so long time», «such long time» — xato.

rows: I haven't seen you for **so long**.
I haven't seen you for **such a long time**.
I didn't know it was **so far**.
I didn't know it was **such a long way**.
Why did you buy **so much** food?
Why did you buy **such a lot of** food?
There were **so many** people.
There were **such a lot of** people.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «It was so nice day» → **such a** nice day; «a such good film» → **such a** good film; «such a beautiful weather» → **such** beautiful weather (weather sanalmaydi); «so much people» → **so many** people; «for so long time» → for **so long** / for **such a long time**; «It's such cold» → It's **so** cold.

Tanlash usuli: «shunchalik» dan keyingi so'zga qarang. **Ot** bor bo'lsa (sifat bilan yoki sifatsiz) — **such**; faqat **sifat yoki ravish** bo'lsa — **so**. Tekshirish uchun gapni aylantiring: **such a** hot day = the day was **so** hot.
Adashtirmang: **such as** = «masalan, kabi»: big cities **such as** London and Tashkent. **I think so / I hope so** dagi so — boshqa vazifa (→ 51-dars).

rows: **so** + sifat / ravish
**so** tired, **so** quickly
**such a / an** + sifat + birlik ot
**such a** nice day
**such** + sifat + ko'plik / sanalmaydigan ot
**such** kind people, **such** bad weather
**so** cold **that** ... / **such** a cold day **that** ...
**so much / many** = **such a lot of**
**so many** cars / **such a lot of** cars
**so long / far** = **such a long time / way**
for **so long** / for **such a long time**

examples.title: **so** + adjective / adverb
examples.description: so sifat yoki ravishdan oldin keladi — ot yo'q. Ko'pincha his-tuyg'u bilan yoki vaziyatdan ma'lum narsa haqida.

sentences.text: I'm **so** tired — I worked twelve hours today.
sentences.translation: **Juda ham** charchadim — bugun o'n ikki soat ishladim.

sentences.text: Why are you **so** late? We've been waiting for an hour!
sentences.translation: Nega **bunchalik** kechikding? Bir soatdan beri kutyapmiz!

sentences.text: The water in the lake was **so** clear and cold!
sentences.translation: Ko'ldagi suv **shunaqangi** tiniq va sovuq ekan!

sentences.text: Your daughter has grown **so** quickly — she's almost as tall as you.
sentences.translation: Qizingiz **shunchalik** tez o'sibdi — deyarli bo'yingizga yetibdi.

sentences.text: Thank you **so much** for your help with the move.
sentences.translation: Ko'chishda yordam berganingiz uchun **juda katta** rahmat.

sentences.text: Don't drive **so** fast — there's a speed camera on this road.
sentences.translation: **Bunchalik** tez haydama — bu yo'lda tezlik kamerasi bor.

sentences.text: Everyone was **so** kind to me when I first arrived in London.
sentences.translation: Londonga ilk kelganimda hamma menga **juda** mehribon bo'ldi.

sentences.text: How did Bekzod learn English **so** well in just a year?
sentences.translation: Bekzod qanday qilib bir yildayoq ingliz tilini **bunchalik** yaxshi o'rgandi?

sentences.text: The new phones are **so** expensive these days!
sentences.translation: Hozir yangi telefonlar **juda ham** qimmat!

sentences.text: I didn't realise the exam would be **so** difficult.
sentences.translation: Imtihon **bunchalik** qiyin bo'lishini bilmagan edim.

examples.title: **such a** + adjective + noun
examples.description: such a / an + (sifat) + birlik ot. such artikldan oldin turadi: such a nice day, a such emas.

sentences.text: We had **such a** lovely time at your wedding!
sentences.translation: To'yingizda **shunaqangi** ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik!

sentences.text: Madina is **such a** kind person — she always helps her neighbours.
sentences.translation: Madina **juda** mehribon odam — doim qo'shnilariga yordam beradi.

sentences.text: Why did you buy **such an** expensive car?
sentences.translation: Nega **bunday** qimmat mashina sotib olding?

sentences.text: London is **such an** exciting city to live in.
sentences.translation: London — yashash uchun **juda** qiziqarli shahar.

sentences.text: I've never seen **such a** long queue at the post office.
sentences.translation: Pochtada **bunchalik** uzun navbatni hech ko'rmaganman.

sentences.text: Don't be **such a** baby — it's only a small injection!
sentences.translation: **Yosh boladek** qilma — bor-yo'g'i kichkina ukol-ku!

sentences.text: It's **such a** pity that you can't come to the party.
sentences.translation: **Juda afsus**, ziyofatga kela olmas ekansan.

sentences.text: Who made **such a** mess in the kitchen?
sentences.translation: Oshxonada **bunaqa** tartibsizlikni kim qildi?

sentences.text: Bukhara has **such a** long history — over two thousand years!
sentences.translation: Buxoroning tarixi **shunchalik** qadimiy — ikki ming yildan ortiq!

sentences.text: Sorry, I'm in **such a** hurry this morning — can we talk later?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bugun ertalab **juda** shoshib turibman — keyinroq gaplashsak bo'ladimi?

examples.title: **such** + plural / uncountable: **such** nice people
examples.description: Ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlarda a yo'q: such nice people, such awful weather, such good advice, such fun.

sentences.text: Your parents are **such** nice people — I really enjoyed meeting them.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz **shunday** yaxshi odamlar ekan — ular bilan tanishganimdan juda xursandman.

sentences.text: We've had **such** awful weather this summer.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz **shunaqangi** yomon havo bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Thank you — you've given me **such** good advice.
sentences.translation: Rahmat — menga **juda** foydali maslahat berdingiz.

sentences.text: I didn't expect **such** terrible traffic on a Sunday morning.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba ertalab **bunchalik** dahshatli tirbandlik bo'lishini kutmagandim.

sentences.text: The kids had **such** fun at the water park.
sentences.translation: Akvaparkda bolalar **rosa maza qilishdi**.

sentences.text: Why do you always tell **such** silly jokes?
sentences.translation: Nega doim **bunaqa** bema'ni hazillar aytasan?

sentences.text: These are **such** beautiful photos — did you take them yourself?
sentences.translation: Bular **shunday** chiroyli suratlar — o'zing olganmisan?

sentences.text: It's hard to believe that **such** small children can play the piano.
sentences.translation: **Bunchalik** kichkina bolalar pianino chala olishiga ishonish qiyin.

sentences.text: I've never tasted **such** delicious apricots — where did you buy them?
sentences.translation: **Bunaqa** shirin o'rikni hech tatib ko'rmaganman — qayerdan oldingiz?

sentences.text: Congratulations! That's **such** good news about your new job!
sentences.translation: Tabriklayman! Yangi ishing haqidagi xabar **juda ham** quvonarli!

examples.title: Result: **so** ... **that**
examples.description: so + sifat / ravish + that ... — «shunchalik ... ki». Og'zaki nutqda that tushib qolishi mumkin.

sentences.text: The film was **so** long **that** I fell asleep before the end.
sentences.translation: Film **shunchalik** uzun ediki, oxirigacha uxlab qoldim.

sentences.text: Jasur was **so** nervous **that** he forgot his own phone number.
sentences.translation: Jasur **shunchalik** hayajonlandiki, o'z telefon raqamini unutib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: The soup was **so** hot **that** I burnt my tongue.
sentences.translation: Sho'rva **shunchalik** issiq ediki, tilimni kuydirib oldim.

sentences.text: She spoke **so** quietly **that** nobody at the back could hear her.
sentences.translation: U **shunchalik** past ovozda gapirdiki, orqadagilar hech narsa eshitmadi.

sentences.text: I was **so** busy last week **that** I didn't even have time for lunch.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta **shunchalik** band edimki, tushlik qilishga ham vaqtim bo'lmadi.

sentences.text: The questions were **so** difficult **that** half the class failed.
sentences.translation: Savollar **shunchalik** qiyin ediki, sinfning yarmi yiqildi.

sentences.text: Emma was **so** happy with the result she phoned everyone she knew.
sentences.translation: Emma natijadan **shunchalik** xursand bo'ldiki, tanigan hammaga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: On the motorway the traffic was moving **so** slowly **that** we decided to turn back.
sentences.translation: Avtomagistralda mashinalar **shunchalik** sekin yurayotgan ediki, ortga qaytishga qaror qildik.

sentences.text: Our flat is **so** small **that** we can't invite more than four guests.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramiz **shunchalik** kichkinaki, to'rttadan ortiq mehmon chaqira olmaymiz.

sentences.text: Grandpa's stories were **so** funny **that** we laughed until we cried.
sentences.translation: Bobomning hikoyalari **shunchalik** kulgili ediki, ko'zimizdan yosh chiqquncha kuldik.

examples.title: Result: **such** ... **that**
examples.description: such + (a) + sifat + ot + that ... — natija. Ot bor bo'lgani uchun so emas, such.

sentences.text: It was **such** a lovely evening **that** we walked home instead of taking a taxi.
sentences.translation: **Shunday** yoqimli oqshom ediki, taksiga o'tirmay uyga piyoda qaytdik.

sentences.text: Aziz has **such** a loud voice **that** he never needs a microphone.
sentences.translation: Azizning ovozi **shunchalik** balandki, unga hech qachon mikrofon kerak bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: They're **such** good friends **that** they talk on the phone every day.
sentences.translation: Ular **shunday** qadrdon do'stlarki, har kuni telefonda gaplashishadi.

sentences.text: We had **such** a terrible flight **that** we'll never use that airline again.
sentences.translation: **Shunaqangi** dahshatli parvoz bo'ldiki, o'sha aviakompaniyadan boshqa hech qachon foydalanmaymiz.

sentences.text: Samarkand made **such** a strong impression on me **that** I went back the next year.
sentences.translation: Samarqand menda **shunday** kuchli taassurot qoldirdiki, keyingi yili yana bordim.

sentences.text: There was **such** a long queue **that** we gave up and went home.
sentences.translation: Navbat **shunchalik** uzun ediki, umidimizni uzib uyga ketdik.

sentences.text: It was **such** an important meeting **that** nobody was allowed to leave early.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish **shunchalik** muhim ediki, hech kimga erta ketishga ruxsat berilmadi.

sentences.text: Oliver gave **such** a funny speech **that** the whole room was laughing.
sentences.translation: Oliver **shunday** kulgili nutq so'zladiki, butun zal kulardi.

sentences.text: The hotel had **such** comfortable beds **that** we didn't want to get up.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonadagi karavotlar **shunday** qulay ediki, turgimiz kelmasdi.

sentences.text: Sarah is **such** a fast reader she finishes a novel in two days.
sentences.translation: Sara **shunchalik** tez o'qiydiki, romanni ikki kunda tugatadi.

examples.title: **so much**, **so many**, **such a lot of**
examples.description: so much + sanalmaydigan, so many + sanaladigan ot; so few / so little. Norasmiy muqobili — such a lot of.

sentences.text: There were **so many** people at the concert that we couldn't see the stage.
sentences.translation: Konsertda **shunchalik ko'p** odam bor ediki, sahnani ko'ra olmadik.

sentences.text: I've got **so much** work to do before Friday.
sentences.translation: Jumagacha qiladigan **juda ko'p** ishim bor.

sentences.text: Why did you cook **so much** food? There are only four of us!
sentences.translation: Nega **bunchalik ko'p** ovqat pishirding? Bor-yo'g'i to'rt kishimiz-ku!

sentences.text: We spent **such a lot of** money in London — everything was expensive.
sentences.translation: Londonda **juda ko'p** pul sarfladik — hamma narsa qimmat edi.

sentences.text: Madina has **so few** friends in her new town that she feels lonely.
sentences.translation: Madinaning yangi shahrida do'stlari **shunchalik kamki**, o'zini yolg'iz his qiladi.

sentences.text: There's **so little** time left — we'll have to hurry.
sentences.translation: Vaqt **juda kam** qoldi — shoshilishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: Kate has **such a lot of** clothes that she can't close her wardrobe.
sentences.translation: Keytning kiyimlari **shunchalik ko'pki**, shkafini yopa olmaydi.

sentences.text: I've never seen **so many** stars as in the desert near Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Buxoro yaqinidagi cho'ldagidek **bunchalik ko'p** yulduzni hech qayerda ko'rmaganman.

sentences.text: Thank you for **such a lot of** help with my application.
sentences.translation: Arizam bo'yicha **shuncha ko'p** yordam berganingiz uchun rahmat.

sentences.text: You drink **so much** coffee — no wonder you can't sleep!
sentences.translation: **Shunchalik ko'p** qahva ichasan — uxlay olmasliging ajablanarli emas!

examples.title: **so long** / **such a long time**, **so far** / **such a long way**
examples.description: long va far yolg'iz — so; ot bilan (time, way) — such a. «so long time» — xato.

sentences.text: I haven't seen you for **so long** — how are you?
sentences.translation: Seni ko'rmaganimga **ancha bo'ldi** — qalaysan?

sentences.text: We haven't been to the mountains for **such a long time**.
sentences.translation: Tog'ga bormaganimizga **ancha vaqt** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: I didn't know Khiva was **so far** from Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Xiva Toshkentdan **bunchalik uzoq** ekanini bilmasdim.

sentences.text: Why did you walk **such a long way**? You could have taken the bus.
sentences.translation: Nega **shuncha uzoq yo'lni** piyoda bosib o'tding? Avtobusga chiqsang bo'lardi-ku.

sentences.text: It took **so long** to get a visa that I almost cancelled the trip.
sentences.translation: Viza olish **shunchalik uzoq** cho'zildiki, safarni bekor qilishimga sal qoldi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza spent **such a long time** in the shower that the hot water ran out.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza dushda **shunchalik uzoq** qoldiki, issiq suv tugab qoldi.

sentences.text: Is the airport really **so far** away? — Yes, it's about fifty kilometres.
sentences.translation: Aeroport rostdan ham **shunchalik uzoqmi**? — Ha, taxminan ellik kilometr.

sentences.text: We drove **such a long way** that the kids fell asleep in the car.
sentences.translation: **Shunchalik uzoq yo'l** yurdikki, bolalar mashinada uxlab qolishdi.

sentences.text: Sorry it took me **so long** to reply — I was on holiday.
sentences.translation: Javob berishim **bunchalik cho'zilgani** uchun uzr — ta'tilda edim.

sentences.text: Bekzod has worked for the company for **such a long time** that everyone knows him.
sentences.translation: Bekzod kompaniyada **shunchalik uzoq vaqtdan beri** ishlaydiki, uni hamma taniydi.

examples.title: Dialogue: back from a wedding in Samarkand
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki do'st Samarqanddagi to'y haqida gaplashadi — so, such, so many, such a long way.

sentences.text: — Welcome back, Aziz! I heard the wedding was **such** a big event!
sentences.translation: — Xush kelibsan, Aziz! To'y **shunaqangi** katta bo'lganmish!

sentences.text: — It was! There were **so many** guests that I lost count after five hundred.
sentences.translation: — Ha! Mehmonlar **shunchalik ko'p** ediki, besh yuzdan keyin sanashdan adashdim.

sentences.text: — Five hundred? That's **such a lot of** people!
sentences.translation: — Besh yuz? Bu **juda ko'p** odam-ku!

sentences.text: — And the food was **so** delicious — the best plov I've ever had.
sentences.translation: — Ovqatlar esa **shunaqangi** mazali edi — hayotimdagi eng zo'r palov.

sentences.text: — You're **so** lucky! Did you dance all night?
sentences.translation: — Sen **juda** omadlisan! Tun bo'yi raqs tushdingmi?

sentences.text: — Of course! The music was **so** loud that my ears are still ringing.
sentences.translation: — Albatta! Musiqa **shunchalik** baland ediki, quloqlarim hali ham shang'illayapti.

sentences.text: — And how was the drive back? It's **such a long way**.
sentences.translation: — Qaytish yo'li qanday bo'ldi? **Juda uzoq yo'l**-ku.

sentences.text: — It took **so long** because of the roadworks near Jizzakh.
sentences.translation: — Jizzax yaqinidagi yo'l ta'miri tufayli **juda uzoq** cho'zildi.

sentences.text: — Poor you! You must be **so** tired after **such** a busy weekend.
sentences.translation: — Bechora! **Shunaqangi** gavjum dam olish kunlaridan keyin **juda** charchagan bo'lsang kerak.

sentences.text: — I am, but it was **such** fun that I'd do it all again tomorrow!
sentences.translation: — Charchadim, lekin **shunaqangi** maza bo'ldiki, ertaga yana qaytarishga tayyorman!
